calendars.name: ecb
calendars.note: ECB euro reference rates: published ~16:00 CET on TARGET business days; Frankfurter polls ECB at cron '*/30 14-16 * * 1-5' UTC (db/seeds/providers/ecb.json), so new data lands ~16:00-16:30 Berlin. 2026 holidays confirmed by recordings (000053-000058: 12-25/26, 01-01, Good Friday, Easter Monday, May 1 absent); 2027-2028 from the TARGET calendar (ECB). 2029-2040 generated from the same TARGET rule (New Year, Good Friday, Easter Monday, 1 May, 25/26 Dec; Easter via the Gregorian computus) — documentation, not recordings.

collections.name: ecb_history
collections.description: One record: the full EUR-base daily ECB history (GET /v1/1999-01-04.., exchange 000138). The rates handler flattens it to date -> {currency: rate}.

collections.name: currency_names
collections.description: The recorded /currencies object (code -> name); a single record keyed by its EUR name.

notes: Frankfurter v1 is deprecated (Deprecation: @1779103800, Link rel=successor-version to /v2/...). The fake mirrors the real Rack middlewares (V1::Deprecation, NoStoreOnError, Noindex, Rack::Cors) in middleware.py.

Data: the ECB history is frozen at the last recording (2026-10-09). When the fake clock passes later ECB publications (calendar 'ecb'), those fixings are synthesized by carrying the 2026-10-09 rates forward: dates advance exactly like the real API but values do NOT move (zero day-over-day change). For trend/volatility evaluations pin the fake clock inside the recorded window (<= 2026-10-09) via the admin API.

Writes: none exist. Non-GET verbs (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) were not probed (mutations not approved). Per source (Roda r.is matches any verb) they are served like GET, and the fake does the same (middleware.py rewrites the method) — source-derived, unverified against the live API.
Today = the fake clock's UTC date (Ruby Date.today on a UTC server).

Publication rollover: /latest switches at 16:30 Europe/Berlin on TARGET days (Frankfurter's ECB poll cron). The real API sits behind Cloudflare (cf-cache-status HIT, age up to 1399 s, cache-control max-age=86400), so real clients may see the new fixing later than 16:30. The exact real rollover was not observed: recordings and parity ran on Sunday 2026-10-11.

Some recordings are filed under the wrong endpoint by the recorder (/v1, /v1/, /v1/openapi.json under /v1/currencies; 304s for /v1/2026-10-08 under /v1/latest; /v1/.. under {start_date}..{end_date}). Their properties were removed from the affected observed_schemas by hand; date-keyed rate maps are collapsed into additionalProperties.

invariants.name: currency_names_cover_history
invariants.description: Every currency that /latest, /{date} or the periods can return also has a name for /currencies (recorded names + documented legacy names).
